name: Google Credentials
description: Google Credentials stores credentials for Google Cloud services.
project_description:
Google Cloud Credentials Module 

 The Google Cloud Credentials module provides a secure and centralized way to manage Google Cloud credentials within your Drupal site. This module is designed to store and manage service account credentials, making it easier for other modules in your suite to access and interact with Google Cloud services.

 Features 
 This module includes the following features:

 
 Centralized Credential Management: Securely store and manage Google Cloud service account credentials in a central location. 
 Easy Integration: Allows other Drupal modules to seamlessly access Google Cloud services by utilizing the stored credentials. 
 Simplified Configuration: Provides a straightforward administrative interface for uploading and managing credentials. 
 Secure Storage: Ensures credentials are stored securely, leveraging Drupal’s best practices for sensitive data handling. 
 
 Use Cases 
 Use cases for this module include:

 
 Shared Access to Google Cloud Services: Allows multiple modules within a Drupal installation to access Google Cloud services without needing to individually manage credentials. 
 Secure Credential Management: Provides a secure, centralized approach to managing service account credentials, reducing the risk of misconfiguration or security breaches. 
 Streamlined Module Development: Simplifies the process of integrating Google Cloud services into custom modules by providing a ready-to-use credential management system. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module, follow these steps to configure and use it:

 
 Navigate to Configuration > Google > Google Cloud Credentials . 
 Upload your Google Cloud service account credentials JSON file. 
 Save the settings to securely store the credentials within your Drupal site. 
 Other modules can now retrieve and use these credentials to interact with Google Cloud services. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires:

 
 Google Cloud Service Account: A service account with appropriate permissions for the Google Cloud APIs you intend to use. 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 If you find this module useful, consider contributing or providing feedback to help improve it. Your support is vital for ongoing development and enhancements.
